craft_notes: Sthāyin: liberation-joy (the shaking-off). Sanskrit first: act (shakes off), source (supreme power), seal (stage-arrival), pivot (final state told) → L4 sets act+source line 1, seal+pivot line 2. Rows: row 1 (told-last — tathocyate closes as 'told' closes). Rupture: dash after 'upborne' — freeing done, sealing begins. Close: period on the telling (stage sealed, teaching turns). Minimal pass: 'upborne' for samutthita (uprisen singable); 'henceforth' cut (telling needs no tail). Read aloud: line 1 shakes (shakes/snare/upborne stressed), dash, line 2 seals (reached/told falling). Rejected: 'saves the stained' — killed: dhunoti shakes, saving imports a savior; 'souls' for samalān — killed: stained-ones kept (souls imports cargo).

lines: She shakes the stained from the snare, by power supreme upborne —
the stage is reached, the final state is told.
l4.sanskrit_cite: dhunoti samalān pāśāt paraśaktisamutthitān / bhūmikāgamanaṃ proktam antāvasthā tathocyate

reads_against.argmap: She shakes the stained ones off from bondage — that is stage-arrival; the final state is told next.
c1_essence: The stained shaken off the snare, supreme-powered — stage-arrival sealed.
